gaps.sentence: We're going to ___ our flight if we don't hurry.
gaps.hint: be too late for a plane
gaps.explanation: 'miss a flight/train/bus' = arrive too late for it.

gaps.sentence: The first edition of the book ___ out in 1998.
Hardly had we sat down ___ the lights went out.
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly … when' is the fixed pair; 'than' belongs to 'no sooner'.

gaps.sentence: They marched through the capital ___ protest.
gaps.explanation: 'In protest' = as a way of protesting.

gaps.sentence: The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.

gaps.sentence: The hotel room wasn't big ___ for three people.
She was ___ the impression that the interview was today.
gaps.explanation: 'Under the impression that …' = believing, perhaps wrongly.
